title: UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUKAGASANA
text:
UBUSHINJACYAHA v. MUKAGASANA
[Rwanda URUKIKO RW’UBUJURIRE – RPAA00925/2024/CA (Nyirandabaruta, J. P.) 20
Gashyantare 2026]
Amategeko agenga imanza nshinjabyaha – Igabanyagihano – Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo
kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu
nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Incamake y’ikibazo: Ubushinjacyaha bwareze Mukagasana mu Rukiko Rwisumbuye rwa
Gasabo, bumukurikiranyeho icyaha cyo kubika no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge byo mu bwoko
bw’urumogi, nyuma yo gufatanwa boules 7 yari abitse mu mwambaro we w’akazi wa Top Security
Company LTD aho akorera ku igaraje rya KBS, bagiye no mu rugo rwe bahasanga izindi boules
61 z’urumogi. Mukagasana yemeye icyaha avuga ko ari umuntu wamuhaye urwo rumogi, ngo
hazaza undi muntu arumuhe amuhe amafaranga.
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwaciye urubanza, rwemeza ko Uregwa ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gucuruza
ibiyobyabwenge byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi, rumuhanisha igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw. Uregwa yajuririye iki cyemezo bwa mbere mu Rukiko Rukuru mu guca urubanza
rumugabanyiriza igihano, rumuhanisha igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
Uregwa yongeye ajuririra muri uru Rukiko rw’Ubujurire asaba kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano
agahabwa igihano gito kiri munsi y’igiteganywa n’itegeko kuko akomeje kwemera icyaha, aribwo
bwa mbere akurikirwanywe n’inkiko, kandi akaba yarasize abana ubu babaye umuzigo kuri Leta.
Ubushinjacyaha buvuga ko igihano Uregwa yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka hakurikijwe
ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2 y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº
68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, bityo ubujurire bwe
bukaba nta shingiro bufite.
Incamake y’icyemezo: Icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya burundu ntigishobora kugabanyirizwa
igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15
n’ihazabu ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyo cyaha.
Ubujurire nta shingiro bufite.
Amategeko yashingiweho:
Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya 2.
Itegeko Nº 69/2019 ryo ku wa 08/11/2019 rihindura itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, ingingo ya ya 11.
Imanza zifashishijwe:
RPAA00538/2024/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025.

RPAA00048/2020/CA, Ubushinjacyaha na Bimenyimana Jean Paul, rwaciwe n’Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire ku wa 26/05/2022.
Urubanza
I. IMITERERE Y’URUBANZA
[1] Ku wa 06/05/2021 saa 17h00, mu Mudugudu wa Murambi, Akagari ka Cyimo, Umurenge
wa Masaka, Akarere ka Kicukiro, ku makuru bahawe n’abaturage, ishami rya Police rishizwe
kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge (ANU) ryafashe Mukagasana Séraphine afite “boules” 7 z’urumogi
azibitse mu mwambaro w’akazi wa Top Security Company LTD aho akorera ku igaraje rya KBS,
bagiye no mu rugo rwe bahasanga izindi “boules” 61 z’urumogi. Ubushinjacyaha bwamuregeye
Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo icyaha cyo kubika no gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge byo mu bwoko
bw’urumogi, busaba ko ahanishwa igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu ya 20.000.000Frw.
Mukagasanga Séraphine yaburanye yemera icyaha avuga ko urumogi ari umuntu warumuhaye ngo
hazaze undi muntu arumuhe amuhe amafaranga.
[2] Mu rubanza RP00658/2021/TGI/GSBO rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rwisumbuye rwa Gasabo, ku
wa 08/07/2021, rwemeje ko Mukagasanga Séraphine ahamwa n’icyaha cyo gucuruza
ibiyobyabwenge byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi, rumuhanisha igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu ya
20.000.000Frw.
[3] Mukagasanga Séraphine yajuririye Urukiko Rukuru, mu rubanza
RPA01273/2021/HC/KIG, rwaciwe ku wa 22/08/2024, rwamugabanyirije igihano, rumuhanisha
igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw.
[4] Mukagasana Séraphine yajuririye Urukiko rw’Ubujurire, ubujurire bwe bwandikwa kuri
RPAA00925/2024/CA, iburanisha rishyirwa ku wa 03/02/2026, Mukagasana Séraphine yitabye
yunganiwe na Me Micomyiza Liliane naho Ubushinjacyaha buhagarariwe na Ninahazwa
Roselyne, Umushinjacyaha ku rwego rw’Igihugu.
[5] Mu mwanzuro we w’ubujurire wo ku wa 30/08/2024 no mu miburanire, Mukagasana
Séraphine n’Avoka umwunganira basaba kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano agahabwa igihano gito
kiri munsi y’igiteganywa n’itegeko kuko hari n’abandi baregwa icyaha nk’icye bahanishijwe
igifungo cy’imyaka 4, 5, 6 kandi akaba akomeje kwemra icyaha, aribwo bwa mbere
akurikirwanywe n’inkiko kandi akaba yarasize abana ubu babaye umuzigo kuri Leta.
[6] Uhagarariye Ubushinjacyaha avuga ko ubujurire bwa Mukagasana Séraphine nta shingiro
bufite kuko igihano yahawe aricyo gito gishoboka hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’ingingo ya 2
y’Itegeko Nº 059/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura Itegeko Nº 68/2018 ryo ku wa 30/08/2018
riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange, mu gace kayo ka (a) na (d), riteganya ko igifungo cya
burundu gishobora kugabanywa ariko ntikijye munsi y’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu itari munsi ya kimwe
cya kane cy’igihano cy’ihazabu gito giteganyirijwe icyaha cyakozwe.
UKO URUKIKO RUBIBONA

[7] Impaka zerekeranye no kumenya niba igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15)
n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw Mukagasana Séraphine yahanishijwe gishobora kugabanywa.
[8] Ibyerekeranye no kugabanyiriza igihano umuburanyi wahamijwe icyaha gihanishwa
igifungo cya burundu n’ihazabu mu gihe hari impamvu nyoroshyacyaha cyatanzweho umurongo
mu rubanza RPAA00538/2024/CA, rwaciwe n’Urukiko rw’Ubujurire ku wa 21/01/2025 haburana
Ubushinjacyaha na Cyuzuzo Jean Claude (igika cya 12). Muri urwo rubanza Cyuzuzo Jean Claude
wahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5,000,000Frw
kubera guhamwa n’icyaha cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, yajuririye Urukiko
rw’Ubujurire asaba ko yakongera kugabanyirizwa igihano. Uru Rukiko mu gika cya 12 cy’urwo
rubanza, rwemeje ko mu manza zitandukanye zaciwe ku bahamijwe icyaha cyo gucuruza urumogi
bahanishijwe n’Urukiko Rukuru igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw
hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha, bakajurira basaba kongera kugabanyirizwa igihano, uru
Rukiko rwifashishije ibyemejwe mu rubanza RPAA00048/2020/CA rwaciye ku wa 26/05/2022
haburana Ubushinjacyaha na Bimenyimana Jean Paul1, rwemeje ko imanza zose zaciwe mbere
y’uko Itegeko Nº 59/2023 ryo ku wa 04/12/2023 rihindura ingingo ya 60 y’Itegeko Nº 68/2018
ryo ku wa 30/08/2018 riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano muri rusange yateganyaga uburyo bwo
kugabanya ibihano risohoka, zitagikoreshwa, maze rwemeza ko icyaha gihanishwa igifungo cya
burundu kidashobora kugabanyirizwa igihano hashingiwe ku mpamvu nyoroshyacyaha ku buryo
kijya munsi y’igifungo cy’imyaka 15; kandi ko n’ihazabu iteganyijwe idashobora kugabanywa
ngo ibe yajya munsi ya kimwe cya kane cy’ihazabu nto iteganyirijwe icyaha.
[9] Kubera izo mpamvu, uru Rukiko rurasanga ubujurire bwa Mukagasana Séraphine nta
shingiro bufite kuko igihano yahawe n’Urukiko Rukuru cy’igifungo cy’imyaka 15 n’ihazabu ya
5.000.000Frw ku cyaha yahamijwe cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge by’urumogi, ari cyo gito
gishoboka ku cyaha yahamijwe cyo gucuruza ibiyobyabwenge byo mu bwoko bw’urumogi, bityo
kikaba kidashobora kongera kugabanywa.
II. ICYEMEZO CY’URUKIKO
[10] Rwemeje ko ubujurire bwa Mukagasana Séraphine nta shingiro bufite.
[11] Rwemeje ko imikirize y’urubanza RPA01273/2021/HC/KIG, rwaciwe n’Urukiko Rukuru,
ku wa 22/08/2024, igumyeho mu ngingo zarwo zose.
[12] Rutegetse ko igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka cumi n’itanu (15) n’ihazabu ya 5.000.000Frw
Mukagasana Séraphine yahanishijwe kigumyeho.
1 Uru rubanza mu gika cyarwo cya 26 rwasobanuye ibijyanye n’uko Umurongo wari uriho udashobora gukurikizwa
mu gihe itegeko wari ushingiyeho ryavuyeho cyangwa ryahinduwe.
